title: The Crownways open at level 40
changes: Five Crownways open at level 40, one in every homeland: the Greenward Gate in Oakvale, the Mourning Gate on the moors, the Red Gate in the badlands, the Deep Gate in the sinkholes and the Sun Gate in the Sunscar.
They lead to the Crown of the Marches, the ruined kingdom of the last High King: pale granite cliffs, fallen statues, snapped spires and braziers burning round the Crown Keep.
Tollcross, the Truce Market outside the Keep, is a safe place to rest. The rest of the land is quiet for now: monsters and quests are on the way.
